spans.s:
रघ् रघ् (= rt. रक्), cl. 10. P. राघयति,
to taste, relish; to obtain; cl. 1. A. रङ्घते,
&c., to go, (see rt. रङ्घ्); [cf. Lith. ragauja.]

राघ् 1. राघ् [cf. rt. लाघ्], cl. 1. A. रा-
घते, रराघे, राघितुम्, to be able or
competent: Caus. राघयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अर-
राघत्.
2. राघ्, राक्, m. an able or efficient person.

रघु रघु, उस्, घ्वी, उ (fr. rt. रंह् or
रङ्घ्), Ved. fleet, rapid, rushing, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-
गामिन्); eager; light (= लघु), fickle; (उस्), m.
a racer, fleet courser (Ved.); N. of an ancient king
and ancestor of Rāma, (in the Raghu-vaṃśa he is
described as the son of Dilīpa and Su-dakṣiṇā, and
in

. the name Raghu is said to have been
given to him as ‘going’ to the end of the Śāstras
and to the destruction of his enemies; he was the
father of Aja, the father of Daśa-ratha, and was
therefore great-grandfather of Rāma; but different
accounts are given of Rāma's genealogy, and in
Rāmāyaṇa

. Raghu is said to be son of
Kakutstha; in the Hari-vaṃśa two Raghus are men-
tioned among the ancestors of Rāma); N. of a son
of Śākya-muni; of the author of the Kavi-darpaṇa;
an abbreviation for Raghu-vaṃśa, q. v.; (अवस्), m.
pl. the Raghus or descendants of Raghu; [cf. रा-
घव.]
—रघु-कार, अस्, m., N. of Kālidāsa the
author of the Raghu-vaṃśa.
—रघु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. produced from a fleet courser or racer.
—र-
घु-टिप्पणी, f., N. of a commentary on the Raghu-
vaṃśa.
—रघु-तनय, अस्, m. son of Raghu, N.
of Rāma.
—रघु-देव, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Virudāvalī; (ई), f., N. of a commentary on
the Tattva-cintāmaṇi by Raghu-deva.
—रघु-द्रु,
उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. going or running quickly, running
like a race-horse.
—रघु-नन्दन, अस्, m. a
descendant or son of Raghu, N. of Rāma; N. of an
author of several treatises on religion and law.
—र-
घु-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of Rāma; of various persons;
of the author of the Rasika-ramaṇa.
—रघु-पति,
इस्, m., N. of Rāma; of the father of the lexicogra-
pher Jaṭā-dhara.
—रघु-पत्म-जंहस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, Ved. light-winged, (Sāy.) having a light-falling
foot (= लघु-पतन-समर्थ-पाद).
—रघु-
पत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. lightly flying, going or
moving quickly; [cf. Lat. acci-piter = Sansk. आशु-
पत्वन्.]
—रघु-प्रतिनिधि, इस्, m. image or
counterpart of Raghu.
—रघु-प्रवर, अस्, m.,
N. of Rāma.
—रघु-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved.
having light or little wrath, mild-tempered, (Sāy. =
लघु-क्रोध); full of eagerness or zeal.
—रघु-
यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going quickly, moving lightly.
—रघु-राम, अस्, m. a proper N.
—रघु-
वंश, अस्, m. the race or family of Raghu; N.
of Kālidāsa's celebrated poem in honour of the race
of Raghu, (it consists of nineteen chapters or books;
cf. महा-काव्य.)
—रघुवंश-तिलक, अस्, m.
‘ornament of the race of Raghu,’ epithet of Rāma.
—रघुवंश-सञ्जीवनी, f., N. of Mallinātha's
commentary on the Raghu-vaṃśa.
—रघु-वर,
अस्, m., N. of Rāma.
—रघु-वर्तनि, इस्, इस्, इ,
Ved. lightly rolling or turning (said of a chariot and
of a horse).
—रघु-वीर, अस्, m., N. of Rāma;
of an author (= Raghu-deva).
—रघु-ष्यद्, त्, त्,
त् (i. e. रघु + स्यद्), Ved. moving quickly, hasty,
speedy, rapid, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-गमन, शीघ्रं
स्यन्दमान.)
—रघूत्तम (˚घु-उत्˚), अस्, m.
‘best of the Raghus,’ N. of Rāma.
—रघूद्वह
(˚घु-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘offspring of Raghu,’ N. of
Rāma.

रघीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of रघु), Ved.
more rapid or fleet, very swift.

रघुयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (Part. fr. an unused Nom.
रघुय), moving fleetly or rapidly, (Sāy. = शीघ्रं
गच्छत्.)
रघूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. = रघुयत् above.

रघुया, ind. (fr. रघु), Ved. quickly, swiftly,
lightly, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्, as if रघु-या.)

राघव राघव, अस्, m. (fr. रघु), a de-
scendant of Raghu; a patronymic of Aja; of Daśa-
ratha; (especially) of Rāma-candra; of a more
recent king (author of the Hasta-ratnāvalī); of the
author of the Gaṇeśa-stuti hymn; of a serpent-
demon; sea, ocean; a species of large fish; (औ),
m. du. the two Rāghavas, i. e. Rāma and Lakṣ-
maṇa.
—राघव-चैतन्य, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—राघव-देव, अस्, m., N. of a poet; of the
father of Dāmodara and grandfather of Śārṅgadhara;
of the author of the Laghu-cintana.
—राघव-
पाण्डवीय, अम्, n., N. of an artificial poem by
Kavi-rāja giving a narrative of the acts of both
Rāghavas and Pāṇḍavas in such a way that it may
be interpreted either as a history of one or the other
family.
—राघव-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a work.
—रा-
घवानन्द (˚व-आन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Hari-nanda; of the author of the Nyāyāvalī-dīdhiti;
of the author of a commentary on the Mānava-
dharma-śāstra.
—राघवानुज-ग (˚व-अन्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, referring to the younger brother of Rāma.
—राघवाभ्युदय (˚व-अभ्˚), अस्, m. ‘rise of
Rāma,’ N. of a drama.
—राघवायण (˚व-
अय्˚), अम्, n. Rāma's history, i. e. the Rāmāyaṇa.
[]
—राघवेन्द्र (˚व-इन्˚), अस्, m. ‘Rāghava-chief,’
N. of several persons.
—राघवेश्वर (˚व-ईश्˚),
‘Rāghava-lord,’ N. of one of Śiva's Liṅgas.

राघवीय, अम्, n. the work composed by Rā-
ghava.
